_animpipe.note: Image upscale for triage keepers only (two-stage cost saving). Uses an ESRGAN model via UpscaleModelLoader. Put e.g. 4x-AnimeSharp / RealESRGAN_x4plus_anime in models/upscale_models. 'scale' is informational here; the ESRGAN model's native factor applies. For video upscaling, run frames through this per-frame in your real workflow.
